hints: Interpret each modulus as a distance on the Argand diagram: \(|z|\) is distance from the origin and \(|z-(1-i)|\) is distance from \(1-i\).
Draw the circle centred at \(0\) with radius \(2\), and the circle centred at \(1-i\) with radius \(1\); both boundaries are included.
Shade only the overlap satisfying both directions: outside or on the first circle and inside or on the second.
walkthrough: Show a circle with centre the origin and radius $2$
Show a circle with centre $1-i$ and radius $1$
Shade the intersection outside or on the circle $|z|=2$ and inside or on the circle centred at $1-i$ with radius $1$.
